<?php
class QuietWeakRefCVEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { global $watch, $target; echo "RECEIVER;"; echo $watch->get() === null ? "WR_GONE;" : "BAD_WR;"; echo $target !== null ? "TARGET_LIVE;" : "BAD_TARGET;"; }
}
$target = new stdClass;
$held = WeakReference::create($target);
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietWeakRefCVEmptyGet;
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
$destination = empty($reader->$selector);
echo $destination === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
$target = null;
$watch = null;
echo "DONE;";

<?php
class QuietWeakRefLiteralEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { global $watch; echo "RECEIVER;"; echo $watch->get() === null ? "WR_GONE;" : "BAD_WR;"; throw new Exception("receiver"); }
}
$target = new stdClass;
$held = WeakReference::create($target);
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$target = null;
echo $held->get() === null ? "EXPIRED;" : "BAD_TARGET;";
$reader = new QuietWeakRefLiteralEmptyGet;
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->value); echo "BAD_DELIVERY;"; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo "CAUGHT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_DESTINATION;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
$watch = null;
echo "DONE;";
